name: The Embalming
description: Seal their flesh with Ectoglue and words that should not be said aloud. They will not fall. They will barely move. Pain is something that happens to the living.

name: Rite of the Hollow Gallop
description: Pour Ectoglue into their nostrils and speak the names of the dead. Their eyes go dark. They will run faster than anything living, and they will not stop when they break.

name: Covenant of Ash
description: Melt Ectoglue into a black candle and speak your enemy's name into the smoke. Whatever fortune either of you carried, the dark takes its share. It is not particular about whose.

name: The Rot
description: Stir Ectoglue into the enemy's water trough before dawn. By the time they ride out, something is already eating them from the inside. It works slowly. It does not stop.

name: The Feast
description: Coat their teeth in Ectoglue and starve them for a night. In the morning they will not want hay. Every bite they take on the field gives back what was taken from them.

name: Raise the Glued
description: Pour Ectoglue back over the grave and call it by name until something answers. What climbs out will ride beside your horses. They will not look at it. Neither should you.

name: Harvest of the Fallen
description: Mark your saddles with Ectoglue in the old sigils. When their horses fall, they do not stay down. They stand back up on your side, and they do not remember whose they were.

name: The Offering
description: Paint the weakest of your herd in Ectoglue and lead it to the front. Everything it was is given to the rest. The others will not look at the empty space where it stood.
